name: Departures
tagline: open-wa as a station departures board: every outgoing WhatsApp message is a departure, flipping from BOARDING to DEPARTED on a mechanical split-flap board, for developers who send order, booking and support messages from their own servers.
logo: A seven-tile split-flap wordmark, open-wa in the brand mono with an amber hyphen; the tiles riffle through letters and land back on themselves, left to right, on load, hover and focus. The favicon is the single 'o' flap tile with its axle pins.
